book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: KORIN KHRISAWBU KHATEI PAUL CAKUA UIKHEHNAH

content: Atoheh cawh nono dangnah batui kong ka cia a. Kaa zongmingtei tah hninah kaa hnui thlu tah cawh kaa hni. Hninah taco cawngsaw a palai a patuisah ka, canghrasala donah taco cawngsaw a tua hry.
Zehmai ka hni thlu thlang tatei a rawhpaw cawngsaw cawh a hni ruapaw a hnih balang lypaw a cang.
Canghrasala Khazing a dopaw cawngsaw cawh Khazing tah ama khah a hni.
Mataico atoheh cawh nono dangnah batui enah kong a cang. Khazaw lehei nono cawh zehmai cang be ca ka, Khazing pakheh tah ly co a hringpaw khazing ung be tah cawh kaa hni.
Alui letah le vaicung letah khazing tatei aa tahpaw a hlupui le abui a hlupui ung he ka, khazing a hlupui le abui a hlupui aa ung tahmai tah,

kaaning kaa caw taco Khazing pakheh suipaw ung ka, Ama cawh Paw khah a cang. Ama taitah hming vytei va chuh he ka, Ama a caw taco kaa hringpaw a cang. Taico Abui pakheh suipaw ung ka, Ama cawh Zisu Khri cang ka, Ama a thong co, hming vytei va chuh he ka, Ama a thong co, kaa hringpaw a cang.

Canghrasala ma heh ming maikaw tah hnih bei he. Cawngsaw thaikhehpaw cawh ato tingtai heh nono kha a pahlawh thlang rawng he tahei, ma hapaw batui cawh aa e tihtah dangnah batui a cang tatah rawh he ka, aa chiachaw thluidangnah lungthing khah a padia a padanah cawtah aa ma papia palui tatah a rawh he.
Canghrasala batui taco Khazing kha a ma nesah be, kaa e ly zong tah chia vy hlui bei peh, kaa e zong tah chah vy hlui bei peh.
Ma duitei cawh zalong teitah naa ungnahpaw cawh a zingnah a padia a padapaw sahlo aa pohlynah a cang ly nápawtah a raering my lo.

Zecawtamaw tatah naaning hninah a hnuipaw sahlo tah nono behnah ing letei batui naa epaw khah a chiachaw thluidangnah lungthing a padia a padapaw tah a ca hmuh caco he, ma taco dangnah batui e ruapaw taco a raechah sá bei maw?
Macawtaco ma a zingnah a padia a padapaw, Khri tei a thih hnopaw unypaw cawh naaning naa hninah tah a ro.
Ma hrahei naa uny sahlo cung letah naa sua tihtah a hmang lypaw tatah aa zingpaw khah a tua sahpaw naa cang cawtah Khri cung letah a suapaw na cang he ceh.
Macawtaco, ka epaw tahei ka unypaw khah suanah lang a tlahsah caco, ma saw cawh e khaw bei neh, ma pawsui co, pakheh tei hmai suanah lang a tlahsah tupaw cang bei neh.
